review_candidates.title: CRM Test Lead
review_candidates.description: About Accenture Accenture is a leading solutions and global professional services company that helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed across the enterprise, bringing together the talent of our approximately 779,000 people, our proprietary assets and platforms, and deep ecosystem relationships. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to be the most AI-enabled, client-focused, great place to work in the world. Through our Reinvention Services we bring together our capabilities across strategy, consulting, technology, operations, Song and Industry X with our deep industry expertise to create and deliver solutions and services for our clients. Our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity, and we measure our success by the 360° value we create for all our stakeholders. Visit us at accenture.com. Accenture | Let there be change Across industries and around the world, we’re creating better experiences for people using emerging technologies and human ingenuity. Together, we can reinvent anything Role Overview As a Dynamics 365 CRM Tester (Quality Engineer)-Associate Manager at Accenture, you will ensure the highest quality of Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) solutions through comprehensive testing, defect management, and continuous improvement of QA processes. You will validate functional and non-functional requirements, support automation initiatives, and collaborate closely with developers and functional consultants to deliver exceptional solutions aligned with Microsoft best practices. Key Responsibilities Testing Create, execute, and maintain test plans and test cases for Dynamics 365 CE applications, including Sales, Customer Service, and Marketing modules. Perform functional, regression, integration, and performance testing to ensure solution quality. Validate CRM customizations, such as Plugins, Workflows, PCF controls, and Power Platform components. Defect Management Identify, document, and track defects using tools like Azure DevOps or similar platforms. Collaborate with development teams to ensure timely resolution of defects and issues. Quality Assurance Ensure all deliverables meet quality standards through rigorous testing and validation processes. Participate in code reviews and provide feedback from a QA perspective to improve overall solution quality. Automation Implement and maintain automated test scripts using tools like Selenium, EasyRepro, or custom frameworks. Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps to streamline delivery processes. Documentation Maintain comprehensive documentation of test plans, test cases, defect reports, and test results to ensure traceability and knowledge sharing. Experience: 5–8 years of experience in software testing, with at least 3+ years focused on Dynamics 365 CE. Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of testing methodologies and best practices. Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 CE modules, including Sales, Customer Service, and Marketing. Proficiency in automated testing tools, such as LeapWork, Selenium, or EasyRepro. Experience using SQL for database validation and testing. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and Azure DevOps Test Plans. Experience using M365 CoPilot for test case generation. Preferred Skills Experience in performance testing and API testing. Knowledge of Power Platform tools, including Power Apps and Power Automate. Exposure to Copilot and AI-driven CRM features. Certifications (Preferred) Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Fundamentals Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Sales Functional Consultant Associate ISTQB Certified Tester

review_candidates.review_policy: Always pass exact-detail candidate to ChatGPT; closed status, weak keyword evidence, noisy title, or freshness conflict are annotations only
